stage: preparation only; no real model fitting before parent review

split.reserved: All eval_session recordings, including known 40 recordings of ten shared patterns; never fit or score
split.grouping: drummer includes all sessions; exact-byte duplicate crossing proposed groups blocks preparation rather than silently moves records

selection.order: SHA256 then id within each drummer, non-eval only
selection.rule: Whole performance only. No truncation; report ineligible records. Fixed candidate selection before near-pattern flags; no replacement after flagged exclusion.
selection.exclusions: Report reserved, over-event-cap, nonselected, unsupported, duplicate and unresolved-strong-match counts separately; no post-result candidate substitution.

screen.all_inventory: Exact bytes and exact ordered (onset tick, drum instrument key) signature; signature excludes velocity/controllers and is not full performance identity; selected cross-split comparisons additionally require full instrument/IOI fingerprint with first onset offset removed and remaining integer IOIs divided by their GCD (exact rational tempo scaling invariant, not jitter invariant).
screen.approximate: For selected candidates versus all non-eval records in different drummer splits: set Jaccard of consecutive eight-event (instrument key, nearest 120-tick IOI bucket) shingles; first IOI measured from zero. Ties round half upward. This lossy representation is comparison-only, never training input.
screen.flag_rule: Jaccard >= 0.80 marks unresolved candidate; any exact onset/key signature match marks unresolved. Flagged selected recordings cannot enter fit without subsequent explicit review.
screen.limitations: Not exhaustive musical or legal duplication detection. Eight-event windows can match common grooves; jitter or long variation may evade whole-record Jaccard. No threshold tuning or independent-pattern guarantee.
screen.candidate_details: Report overlap shingle counts, Jaccard and containment denominators, first matching event indices and eight-event window length. Weak common-window hits are descriptive; fixed >=0.80 Jaccard or full fingerprint match quarantines selected recording.

proposed_baseline.target: Exact integer inter-onset ticks, fixed PPQ480; chronological positive-velocity channel9 note-ons; same-tick source order retained
proposed_baseline.support: 0..30720 ticks inclusive; entire selected recording fails support if any target outside, no clipping or quantization
proposed_baseline.control: Empirical IOI unigram plus total prior mass1 uniform over support
proposed_baseline.comparison: Previous drum instrument-key conditional IOI with fixed count shrinkage k4 toward same unigram, reset at every performance; first event uses unigram
proposed_baseline.evaluation: Validation and test split descriptive predictive NLL and support coverage with per-performance and pooled denominators; no fresh generalization guarantee or musical quality inference
proposed_baseline.generation: Not part of this first baseline; no melodic pitch model, no synthesized audio
proposed_baseline.unknown_instrument: Previous-key context absent in train backs off to same positive unigram; instrument identities are conditioning labels only, not predicted pitch. All IOI support values positive.

preservation: Original MIDI bytes, PPQ480, expressive timing, velocities, controls remain unchanged; event projection is timing analysis only, not lossless MIDI editing.
holdout_status: All corpus inventory metadata previously observed; no predictive model score yet. Original release splits preserved as historical metadata, not used as independent splits. Proposed withheld performances are not claimed to be unobserved patterns.
